text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Year Summer Training Camp is finally starting!
We need to build up our strength even more here for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's make this a great training camp, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Let's make this summer fiery and intense as we gear up for the showdown in autumn—!
